items.markdown:
The **UI/UX Pro Max Skill** is an open-source AI skill created by [Next Level Builder](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill) that provides design intelligence to AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or OpenCode) to prevent generic, template-like AI interfaces.[[1]](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill)[[2]](https://uichemy.com/design-skills/ui-ux-pro-max/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Pc27ThkuBPQ)

### Core Features & Database

- **Searchable UI Styles:** Over 79 styles (50+ active), including Glassmorphism, Neumorphism, and Bento Grid.[[1]](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill)[[2]](https://mcpmarket.com/tools/skills/ui-ux-pro-max-6)
- **Industry Reasoning Rules:** 192 product-type reasoning rules covering landing page structures, color moods, and typography pairings.[[1]](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill)[[2]](https://uichemy.com/design-skills/ui-ux-pro-max/)
- **Design System Generator (v2.0):** Automatically analyzes project requirements to build a complete design system (MASTER.md and page overrides) *before* writing code.[[1]](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill/blob/main/README.md)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Pc27ThkuBPQ)
- **Tech Stack Support:** Built-in guidance for 22 major frameworks and libraries, including React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Vue, iOS, and Android.[[1]](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill)[[2]](https://mcpmarket.com/tools/skills/ui-ux-pro-max-6)
- **Anti-Pattern Guardrails:** Flags and blocks common design mistakes (such as default "AI purple/pink gradients" for corporate or financial apps).[[1]](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill)

### How to Install
You can add the skill to your workflow via package managers or Claude Code plugins:

- **Claude Code / CLI:** `claude /plugin marketplace add nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill` or via `npx skills add nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill`.
- **Local / Manual:** Clone or download the repository from the [GitHub - UI/UX Pro Max Skill](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill) page and run its local Python search script (`search.py`).[[1]](https://www.ui-skills.com/skills/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max)[[2]](https://ui-ux-pro-max-skill.com/)[[3]](https://uichemy.com/design-skills/ui-ux-pro-max/)
